From the shop counter to the online checkout, I build the systems that keep your sales moving and your numbers clear.

POS systems

Billing, barcode scanning, inventory, staff roles and daily reports, tailored to how your shop or restaurant actually works.

FAQ

Questions clients often ask

How much does a project cost?

Every project is priced on its features. After a short free call, you get a written plan with a fixed quote. You approve the price before any work starts, so there are no surprise charges.

How long does it take?

It depends on the scope. A portfolio site is much quicker than a full POS or online store. Your proposal includes a clear timeline, and you get progress updates throughout the build.

Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes. I work remotely with clients in any time zone, using WhatsApp, calls and video meetings, with written updates you can read whenever it suits you.

Can I manage the system myself after launch?

Yes. Online stores come with an admin panel for products and orders, and POS systems include staff training at handover, so your team can run everything day to day.

What happens if something breaks or I need new features?

I stay available after launch for fixes, training and upgrades. When your business grows, the system can grow with it.

Have a project in mind?

Tell me what you need. I'll reply with a clear plan, a timeline and a fixed quote.
